test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: **Select the correctly spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is '**Apparently**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given options the correctly spelt word is '**Apparently**'. • **Apparently**: according to what people say or to how something appears, but perhaps not true. (ऊपरी तौर से; दृश्‍यमान रूप से) • *Example: **Apparently**, he's already been married twice.* **Correct Answer:__** *Apparently.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning and correct spelling of other words: • **Conducive**: helping or making something happen. (सहायक या किसी का कारण बनना) • **Bottleneck**: a narrow piece of road that causes traffic to slow down or stop. (सड़क का वह तंग या संकरा भाग जिसके कारण यातायात मंद पड़ जाता है या रुक जाता है) • **Endogenous**: having an internal cause or origin. (आंतरिक कारण या उत्पत्ति होना) 4a:Ta70, The correct answer is '**Happy**'.
